about.page_subtitle: Learn about our story, mission, and the team behind HIMA.
about.story_p1: HIMA Electromecánica was born from a passion for engineering and a commitment to excellence. Founded by professionals with over 25 years of experience in the electromechanical sector, our company has grown to become a trusted benchmark for highly complex projects in Costa Rica.
about.story_p2: From our first residential projects to the large industrial installations we carry out today, we have always upheld the same principles: technical rigor, on-time delivery, and personalized attention to each client.
about.mission_text: To provide comprehensive and sustainable electromechanical solutions that exceed our clients' expectations, ensuring safety, efficiency, and durability in every project.
about.vision_text: To establish ourselves as one of the best options in the national market for the construction of electromechanical systems, through excellence in project execution and the continuous training of our personnel.
about.value_integrity_desc: We act with honesty and transparency in every interaction with clients and partners.
about.value_excellence_desc: We hold ourselves to the highest technical and service standards in every project.
about.value_innovation_desc: We adopt modern technologies to deliver more efficient and sustainable solutions.
about.value_safety_desc: The safety of our team and clients is our absolute top priority.
about.team1_bio: Electrical engineer with 22 years of experience in large-scale industrial and commercial projects.
about.team2_bio: Specialist in air conditioning and ventilation systems, ASHRAE-certified, with projects in 5 countries.
about.team3_bio: Expert in PLCs, SCADA, and industrial control systems focused on energy efficiency.

services.page_subtitle: Comprehensive technical solutions for every stage of your project.
services.electrical_desc: Design, installation, and certification of low and medium voltage electrical systems. Compliance with the National Electrical Code (NEC) and local regulations. Pole-mounted, pad-mounted, and dry-type electrical transformers, distribution panels, substation and secondary panel installation, lighting and outlet systems, grounding, backup systems, and solar photovoltaic panel systems.
services.hvac_desc: Design and installation of heating, ventilation, and air conditioning systems for commercial, industrial, and data center spaces. Energy optimization, industrial refrigeration, and precision ductwork.
services.automation_desc: Design, installation, and certification of special systems including fire detection systems, burglar alarms, CCTV, access control systems, industrial automation systems, and more.
services.mechanical_desc: Design and installation of potable and hot water piping, wastewater systems, fire suppression systems (NFPA 13), infrastructure piping systems, LP gas systems, stormwater systems, and pumping equipment.
services.maintenance_desc: Preventive and corrective maintenance programs for electrical equipment such as panels and electrical services, lighting circuits and fixtures, outlets and switchgear, special systems including fire detection, CCTV, burglar alarms, access control, motors, transformers, piping networks including potable and hot water, wastewater, stormwater, fire suppression, LP gas, water heaters, on-demand heaters, grease traps, pumping systems, and HVAC systems. We reduce downtime and extend the service life of your assets.
services.management_desc: Comprehensive technical direction of electromechanical works: planning, budgeting, subcontractor coordination, quality control, and delivery of complete as-built documentation packages.
services.why_exp_desc: Team with over 25 years of experience.
services.why_cert_desc: Company and professionals registered with CFIA.
services.why_comp_desc: Projects delivered on time according to established schedules.
services.why_guar_desc: Post-construction support and long-term maintenance programs.
